entities.summary: María Laura Pasquinelli, known as Lala Pasquinelli, is an Argentinian artist, poet, lawyer and activist. She is the founder of Mujeres Que No Fueron Tapa, an organization that critiques the representation of women in media. In 2023, she was listed in BBC's 100 Women list as one of the world's inspiring and influential women.
